name: AiRA Suite Export Plugin
features: Export one or multiple plugins as ZIP
Export one or multiple themes as ZIP from wp-content/themes
Status filter dropdown and quick filter chips
Clickable summary cards for plugin states
REST monitor endpoint with status filter support
AiRA Export Builder page for combined plugin/theme package bundles
Package manifest JSON and README inside exported bundle
Install-safe mode that excludes node_modules, cache, backups, logs, and old ZIP files
Full backup mode for complete plugin/theme file bundles
Live Preview counts selected plugins/themes before export
Export Log history saved in WordPress options
notes: เพิ่ม Phase 2: AiRA Export Builder สำหรับแพ็ก Plugin + Theme Bundle ZIP พร้อม Manifest, README, Safe Exclude, Live Preview และ Export Log โดยคงระบบ Export Plugin/Theme เดิมไว้ครบ
